pattern.description: The tail of a fixed green headline ('Put AI Agents to work for') swaps through categories: the old white word pushes up and out with vertical motion blur while the new phrase rises in from below and settles.
pattern.why_premium: Keeping the sentence stem fixed and cycling only the white category word lets one line carry several use cases; the fast vertical push with motion blur reads as a slot-machine flip landed on the music beat.

build_hint.gsap: Masked line: tl.to('.word-out', {yPercent: -100, opacity: 0, filter: 'blur(6px)', duration: 0.12, ease: 'power2.in'}).fromTo('.word-in', {yPercent: 100, opacity: 0, filter: 'blur(6px)'}, {yPercent: 0, opacity: 1, filter: 'blur(0px)', duration: 0.18, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<0.03'); place each swap on a music beat.
build_hint.remotion: Inside an overflow-hidden span: out word translateY = interpolate(f, [0, 3], [0, -100%]) with blur; in word progress = spring({frame: f - 1, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 300}}), translateY = interpolate(progress, [0, 1], [100, 0])%, blur = interpolate(progress, [0, 1], [6, 0])px.

notes: Pattern is a headline category cycle, not an input field; input_text_cycle is the closest canonical id (kinetic_word_reveal was the alternative). No mask edge visible, the vertical blur may be a motion-blur effect rather than a filter.
